decisions.reason: The carpet still has its own page two years after launch, and keeping a catalog design costs little while demand remains uncertain, so the option is worth holding, though a sibling design (C) was already dropped.
A hand-knotted wool-silk carpet is a premium, made-to-order item with low holding cost and a long sales cycle, so its value is still resolving and keeping the option open is cheap.

The corner bench moved from its own page to a mention in 2024, a possible weakening signal, but the firm still actively promotes it as a new interpretation, so the evidence is not yet enough to abandon it.

The low-pile carpet keeps its dedicated page and costs little to keep listed, so it stays as a low-cost option, although the dropping of the similar Product C suggests the carpet line is being pruned.
The swivel shell chair has kept consistent dedicated presentation and seating is a core furniture category, so the tooling already sunk favors keeping it while its market value unfolds.
